paragraphs: Rav Tavi bar Kisna is mentioned in Eruvin 104b. Yevamot 40b reads “Rav Tuvi.”

notes.text: The frozen first name is קב מבי. The consulted Eruvin104b passage has Rav Tavi bar Kisna; this source discrepancy remains open rather than converting Kav Mevi into an authority name or silently repairing it.

The saved named Davidson Eruvin 104b paragraph has Rav Tavi bar Kisna reporting Shmuel; Yevamot 40b has Rav Tuvi bar Kisna reporting Shmuel. They supply corresponding name forms without deciding Hyman’s frozen קב מבי or its printing/transcription history. The separate Rava bar Kisna notice and its Bava Batra 12a locator remain distinct.

Hyman (vol. III, p. 1036) prints Rav Tavi, רב טבי, where the supplied Hebrew has קב מבי. The consulted Eruvin 104b and Yevamot 40b texts have Tavi and Tuvi respectively, both reporting in Shmuel’s name. Bava Batra 12a separately names Rava bar Kisna in a discussion of vineyard measurements. Hyman’s doubled punctuation after that locator is preserved in the source.
